svg.title: A correlated subquery runs once per outer row
svg.desc: The subquery adds WHERE f2.carrier = f.carrier, so it refers to the outer row. It runs once per outer row, 8 runs in all, each with that row's carrier plugged in: 7.75 for the 4 United flights, 17.5 for the 2 Delta flights, and 6 for the 2 American flights. United's average is computed 4 separate times.
svg.text: A correlated subquery runs once per outer row
The inner query refers to the outer row's carrier, so each row gets its own run with its own answer.
